description: Method constants for the ear-centred EEG face-versus-tree analyses of the manuscript (in preparation). No data and no results are contained here.

units.amplitude: nominal microvolt scale of the recording (not independently calibrated)
units.time: seconds relative to the event marker of image onset (display latency not measured)

channels.label_meaning: the displayed image type, not the participant's emotion or cognitive state

preprocessing.stored_reference: mean of the good ear-system channels (includes Fpz when Fpz is good)
preprocessing.epoch_rejection_channels: good mastoid and in-ear channels after the stored common average (Fpz not tested)

channel_qc.reference_for_qc: per-sample median of the finite neural channels

montage.full: all 11 stored rows (own-mean re-reference leaves them unchanged)
montage.fpz_free: M1, M2 and the eight in-ear rows re-referenced to their own good mean
montage.in_ear: the eight in-ear rows re-referenced to their own good mean
montage.fpz_mastoid: Fpz minus the mean of the good mastoids (one row)
montage.drop_one: delete one electrode and re-reference the other ten to their own good mean

transients.derivation: Fpz minus mean of good mastoids
transients.peak_definition: time of the signed maximum of the derivation
transients.tracker_blink_tolerance: in-sample clock residual plus one 250-Hz sample

lda.scaling: z-score fitted on the training rows only; NaN -> training mean (0)

eegnet_montage_stage.provenance: frozen preregistration network settings and network-control contract of the montage stage

eegnet_transient_stage.seed_rule: 20261111 + s + fold, s in {0, 100, 200}; LOSO fold = participant index (ineligible participants still consume an index); joint fold = index of the (participant, stimulus group) pair in sorted order

splits.salt_note: opaque constant of the original analyses; changing it changes fold membership
splits.stimulus_group_rule: class-stratified; keys ordered by SHA-256(salt + '|' + key); group = rank mod k
splits.joint: train: other participants AND other stimulus groups; test: one participant AND one group
splits.loso: train: other participants (all stimuli, so tree photographs are shared)

regimes.draw_extension_rule: extend LDA draws to 50 if the Monte Carlo SE of the composition contrast exceeds 0.0025 (automated, opt-in: regimes.lda_regimes_adaptive)

inference.two_way_bootstrap: participants x stimulus groups (d_F) or participants x tree photographs (transient rate): mean over resampled cells; the follow-up's photograph-weighted two-way bootstrap of the paired gap is available separately
inference.signflip: exact two-sided over all 2^n sign patterns
inference.inversion_ci: set of mean shifts not rejected by the exact sign-flip test at 0.05

panel.status: post hoc decoder panel, specified in a contract frozen after all earlier results and before its own outcomes; code added in version 0.2.0

xdawn_ts_lr.scaling: per-channel z-score from training epochs (NaN -> 0) before xDAWN; tangent vectors standardised on training epochs
xdawn_ts_lr.known_property: with own-mean referenced montages the leading filter of each class aligns with the near-null common-mode direction (effectively nfilter - 1 informative filters per class); reported, not corrected

eeg_inception_erp.adaptation: re-implemented from the published specification and trained with this package's network protocol; not the original calibration/transfer protocol

label_rules.drop_one: FPZ_LOSS_EXCEEDS_IN_EAR_LOSS if mean < 0, Holm p < 0.05 and CI upper < 0; IN_EAR_LOSS_EXCEEDS_FPZ_LOSS if mean > 0, Holm p < 0.05 and CI lower > 0; otherwise NO_DETECTABLE_DIFFERENCE
label_rules.absent_member: INCOMPLETE; counted as p = 1 in its frozen family (inference.holm_frozen)

nested.design: joint outer folds; three inner splits per outer fold; selection on all retained outer-source epochs; chosen configuration used unchanged for free->free and all->free
